entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-64mm-vxmg-q3vj: http-proxy-middleware `router` host+path substring matching allows Host-header-driven backend routing bypass

http-proxy-middleware `router` host+path substring matching allows Host-header-driven backend routing bypass

Aliases: CVE-2026-55602

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:L/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N
